column2: I can put events in motion to hopefully make the good people of [Root.Capital.GetName] rise up and help me gain control of the [Root.Capital.Kingdom.GetFullName]. For their sake, of course!

[Root.TopLiege.GetTitledName]'s claim to possess the Mandate of Heaven is obviously false, and hopefully I can convince the good people of [Root.Capital.GetName] to arm themselves and help me bring about the rise of a new imperial dynasty.

The [Root.TopLiege.Culture.GetName] Yoke weighs heavily on the necks of honest [Root.Culture.GetName] warriors. Hopefully, I can convince the clans of [Root.Capital.GetName] that only I can lead them to freedom and a glorious future.
